jobs.occupation: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Project SAP Supporter you will help shape how SAP S/4HANA and EWM are used in one of the world’s largest new pharmaceutical facility projects. Working where SAP, warehouse operations and production meet, you will turn operational needs into practical system processes for raw materials and intermediates. From mapping future workflows to testing, building master data and training end-users, you will influence how work is designed before the facility moves into operation.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, ideally within manufacturing, warehouse, supply chain or logistics operations.

• Experience with SAP EWM or other SAP warehouse and logistics processes.

• An technical or academic education within Production Manufacturing, Logistics, IT or a related field.

• Understanding of warehouse operations, material flows or raw material handling.

• The ability to translate operational requirements into practical system and process set-ups.

• A collaborative, team-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively with operators, process specialists, project managers, IT colleagues and external vendors.

Useful, but not essential:

Experience from pharmaceutical production, GMP-regulated manufacturing or large implementation projects.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with the supporter team, project operators and the IT vendor to design, test and implement the SAP and warehouse processes that will support future production. In this role, you will:

• Translate operational needs into SAP processes in collaboration with the IT vendor and project stakeholders.

• Develop training materials for SAP S/4HANA and EWM, and train super-users and end-users as a subject matter expert.

• Take ownership of relevant master data in SAP S/4HANA and EWM.

• Map manual and semi-automated flows for raw materials and intermediates together with operational colleagues.

• Contribute to the design, testing and implementation of SAP S/4HANA and EWM processes covering receiving, storage, movement and mixing of raw materials and intermediates.

• Coordinate the purchasing of raw materials and consumables for testing and production readiness.

• Support logistics activities in the area and contribute to the development of future production planning processes, systems and ways of working.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the API Large Project, where colleagues are designing, constructing, commissioning, qualifying and validating one of the largest new pharmaceutical production facilities in the world.

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale processes and products for the people who need them.

Your closest partners will be the supporter team, project operators, process specialists, project managers, the IT vendor and equipment contractors. You will work across both technology and operations, connecting SAP functionality with the practical realities of warehouse and production processes.

What you can expect here

You will join during the project phase, before systems and processes have been defined. Your SAP and warehouse knowledge will help shape how future operations work, from material flows and master data to user training and production planning.

You will gain broad exposure to SAP implementation, warehouse processes and manufacturing while working closely with specialists on a major greenfield pharmaceutical project. You will be trusted to take ownership of your area, within a collaborative project environment where colleagues solve problems together and keep improving the way future production will run.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600 DKK - 734,400 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you have SAP experience with material, warehouse or logistics processes and want to help shape how a new pharmaceutical facility will operate, we would like to hear from you.

Apply for the Project SAP Supporter position by 27 November 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Hiring Manager Laila Bering Larsen at 30756756.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is looking for a dedicated Manager to take responsibility for GMP equipment qualification and validation at our new manual clinical secondary packaging and labelling facility in Ballerup.

You will be part of a small, agile team supporting clinical trials, helping ensure that high-quality investigational medicinal products reach patients globally with cancer and other serious diseases on time and in full.

As Genmab’s newly established in-house GMP production capability for secondary packaging and labelling, the facility offers a unique opportunity to help establish equipment, processes and ways of working from the beginning. You will play a key role in ensuring that equipment is fit for its intended use, appropriately qualified and maintained in a qualified state throughout its lifecycle.

This is a position with responsibility for leading activities and coordinating stakeholders within your area of expertise. The role does not include line management or direct reports.

The position is based at our Ballerup site and requires on-site presence. You will report to the Associate Director, Team Lead, Global Clinical Supply, based in Ballerup.

Responsibilities

The role combines technical ownership, hands-on qualification activities, GMP documentation and hands-on production work in our manual packaging and labelling operations. Working closely with colleagues in Global Clinical Supply, operations, Quality Assurance, Facility and external suppliers, you will drive activities from defining requirements and planning qualifications through execution, reporting and ongoing lifecycle management.

• Own and coordinate qualification and validation activities for GMP equipment supporting clinical packaging, labelling and storage, ensuring that scope, documentation and testing reflect intended use and identified risks.

• Develop and maintain qualification strategies, plans, risk assessments, User Requirements Specifications and qualification documentation, including protocols and reports for Design, Installation, Operational and Performance Qualification, as applicable.

• Coordinate supplier deliverables and review technical documentation to ensure that equipment and supporting documentation meet defined requirements.

• Take responsibility for temperature mapping and qualification of temperature-controlled storage equipment, including associated monitoring and alarm functions, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

• Establish and maintain the qualified state of equipment through periodic reviews, requalification and assessment of changes, maintenance and calibration activities.

• Lead investigations and resolution of deviations arising during qualification and validation and manage related change controls and CAPAs in collaboration with Quality Assurance and equipment users.

• Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions and equipment lifecycle documentation, ensuring clear responsibilities and practical, compliant routines.

• Contribute to inspection and audit readiness by maintaining complete, traceable documentation and presenting activities within your area of responsibility.

• Drive practical improvements that strengthen equipment reliability, documentation quality and efficient execution of qualification and validation activities.

• Perform hands-on secondary packaging and labelling activities for clinical trials in accordance with approved procedures, batch documentation and GMP, including manual set-up and operation, in-process checks, reconciliation of materials and labels, and timely, accurate completion of batch documentation and logbooks.

As part of a small team, you will also participate in day-to-day secondary packaging and labelling activities for clinical trials. This is an expected part of the role, with the balance between qualification activities and production work varying according to operational needs. Flexibility and a willingness to contribute across tasks are essential to ensuring timely clinical supplies.

Qualifications

• A relevant degree in engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, natural sciences or a related technical field, or equivalent qualifications supported by substantial relevant experience.

• Five or more years of relevant experience in a GMP-regulated environment, including independent responsibility for equipment qualification and validation.

• Demonstrated experience planning, documenting and executing qualification activities, including risk assessments, requirements specifications, test protocols and reports.

• A solid understanding of GMP requirements, equipment lifecycle principles, data integrity and risk-based qualification approaches.

• Experience with deviations, change controls, CAPAs and technical investigations.

• Ability to translate technical and operational requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria and robust documentation.

• Experience working with equipment suppliers and coordinating activities across operations and Quality Assurance.

• Experience with packaging and labelling equipment e.g. Label printers, refrigerators, temperature-controlled storage or monitoring systems is an advantage.

• Experience establishing new equipment or working in a facility start-up environment is considered a plus.

• Hands-on experience with GMP production, ideally secondary packaging and labelling, is an advantage, together with a willingness to complete the training required to perform these activities.

• Proficient in English (written and spoken); Danish is an advantage.

• Good IT skills and willingness to learn new digital tools and systems.

About You

You are a structured and technically curious professional who enjoys taking ownership from initial requirements to completed qualifications and ongoing operation. You combine attention to detail with sound judgment and a practical approach to solving problems.

You are comfortable leading activities through your expertise, building alignment across functions and following up on commitments. You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions constructively and ensure that decisions and conclusions are supported by appropriate documentation.

You thrive in a small team where collaboration and flexibility are essential. You enjoy working close to equipment and operations, and you are motivated by building reliable, practical ways of working in an evolving environment. You can balance changing priorities while maintaining a clear focus on quality, compliance and patient needs.

The Team

You will be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing, joining a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

If this opportunity excites you, please upload your CV and a short cover letter explaining your motivation for the role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled accordingly.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK584.000,00---876.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We are looking for a Senior CMC Project Manager to establish and coordinate Genmab’s approach to PMDA raw-data inspection readiness.

The central expectation is that you will develop, proceduralize and implement an end-to-end process that can be applied consistently:

• Across Genmab programs preparing for PMDA raw data inspections

• Across Genmab internal facilities, CMOs and CROs

A primary deliverable will be a controlled standard operating procedure (SOP), supported by practical tools, templates and training. The SOP will define the process flow, responsibilities, readiness requirements, data retrieval, review, approval and release of responses to PMDA.

You will report to the Director and team lead in Late-Stage Manufacturing Development Project Management within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. You will work closely with CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, internal facilities and external manufacturing and testing partners.

Responsibilities

Process and SOP development

• Establish the end-to-end operating model for PMDA raw-data inspection preparation and response

• Author and coordinate approval of a controlled Genmab SOP covering the process

• Define roles, responsibilities, handoffs, decision points, escalation routes and required records

• Develop supporting work instructions, templates, trackers, readiness criteria and training

• Implement and maintain a process that can be reused across Genmab programs, internal facilities, CMOs and CROs

• Update the process based on mock inspections, PMDA requests and lessons learned

Inspection readiness

• Coordinate risk-based readiness plans with clear scope, ownership, milestones and dependencies

• Support traceability from regulatory dossier content to source documents and underlying raw data

• Confirm data ownership, storage location, responsible custodians, retention and retrieval routes

• Coordinate gap assessments, action tracking, retrieval testing and mock inspections

• Ensure readiness remains current as dossier content, stability data, source documents and systems change

Cross-functional and external coordination

• Coordinate activities across CMC, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and relevant Genmab internal facilities

• Align expectations and handoffs with CMOs, CROs and other external data-generating sites

• Coordinate rapid cross-functional responses when PMDA requests are received

• Provide clear status, risks and recommendations to program and functional governance

• Escalate risks related to unavailable records, legacy systems, archive changes or unclear ownership

**

Experience**

• Master’s degree in science, engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. An advanced degree or relevant certification is an advantage

• Experience coordinating activities across internal functions, facilities, CMOs or CROs

• At least six years of experience in Tech Ops or a related field within a relevant industry, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• Experience with biologics or antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Solid experience managing CDMOs and contract research organizations, with a strong understanding of intellectual property implications

• Sound knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, GMP and regulatory documentation requirements, and their application to CMC project delivery

• Experience supporting PMDA inspections is an advantage and Ability to translate regulatory and operational requirements into practical processes and tools

• Experience implementing process or system improvements, with strong proficiency in project management systems, dashboards, risk-management and reporting tools

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present complex topics and recommendations clearly

About You

You take ownership, set clear priorities and follow through on commitments. You bring structure to complex situations, anticipate risks and use sound judgment to keep projects moving. You are comfortable influencing decisions and constructively challenging assumptions while maintaining trust.

You build relationships across functions and cultures, value a ONE-Team approach and share knowledge openly. You are curious about new approaches, including digital tools, and seek feedback and practical improvements that help colleagues and partners deliver together.

We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role & Department

As QA Specialist for Drug Product and Finished Goods you will be responsible for the GMP quality oversight of commercial for Drug Product & Finished Goods manufactured at external Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). The role is based in Denmark and reports to the Director, Head of QA Commercial – Drug Product & Finished Goods.

You will be part of an experienced and highly skilled QA organization, with this position holding primary accountability for Drug Product & Finished Goods across commercial supply chains. The role interfaces closely with CMOs, partners, and internal subject matter experts across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain, Affiliate QA.

Key Responsibilities

General Compliance

• 
Lead QA representation for Drug Product & Finished Goods in cross-functional Genmab project groups and key external collaborations, providing expert input and ensuring alignment with QA governance and regulatory expectations.

• 
Act as a QA subject matter expert on GMP for biologics Drug Product & Finished Goods, providing expert guidance, supporting resolution of complex quality issues, and ensuring consistent application of quality standards.

• 
Gain and maintain expert knowledge of applicable GMP legislation, guidelines, and industry practices relevant; assess relevance for Genmab activities and ensure structured dissemination of applicable updates to relevant stakeholders.

• 
Lead the resolution of Drug Product & Finished Goods -related quality issues in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, escalating critical or high-risk matters as appropriate to ensure timely and compliant decision-making.

Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS)

• 
Continuously improving PQS: Participate in developing, maintaining, and continuously improving Genmab’s Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) in alignment with applicable GMP and GDP requirements.

• 
Quality Risk Management: Apply and support quality risk management principles in complex PQS activities, providing expert input to risk assessments and mitigation actions.

• 
Procedures: Review/authoring and approval of SOPs, Work Instructions, templates and forms within assigned areas.

• 
Deviation, CAPA, Change Control: Handle and support deviations, CAPAs and change controls, providing expert input and ensuring compliance with procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

• 
Inspections & Audits: Participate in audits and inspections performed by national authorities and internal or external auditors as required.

• 
QMR: Provide expert input to Quality Management Reviews (QMRs) as part of the PQS, contributing to data analysis, trend interpretation and identification of quality risks and improvement opportunities.

• 
Complaints & Recalls: Handle and support complex product complaints and recall-related activities as part of the PQS.

• 
Batch Review & Release: Perform batch review and batch release activities and act as delegated QP and ensure compliance with procedures and regulatory requirements.

• 
APQR: Prepare, review and support complex Annual Product Quality Reviews (APQRs) as part of the PQS.

• 
Training: Provide expert training in complex or specialized quality topics as defined by QA, supporting consistent understanding and application of quality requirements.

Supplier Quality Oversight

• Provide expert and operational supplier quality oversight for Drug Product and Finished Goods manufacturers, including supplier audits, vendor risk evaluations, Quality Agreements, supplier meetings, and external notifications.

• Provide expert input to the resolution of complex -related supplier quality issues, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and Genmab quality standards.

Requirements

• 
 University degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Medicine, Chemistry, Biology, or Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Technology.

• 
Solid experience (5 years) within pharmaceutical QA GMP, preferably related to Drug Product & Finished Goods.

• 
Experience with outsourced manufacturing and delegated QP responsibilities.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English.

• 
Ability to work independently in a complex and fast-paced environment.

• 
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment

• 
Results-oriented and committed to contributing to Genmab’s overall success.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK607.920,00---911.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Statistical learning as a tool to understand host-microbiome-flavour interactions in plant growth
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and dynamic postdoc for a two-year position at the University of Copenhagen, as part of the ongoing Novo Nordisk Foundation funded project ‘Tomatoponics’. The goal of the project is to apply statistical and machine learning tools to multi-omics data including plant genotypes, root microbiomes and fruit shotgun metabolomes to better understand how the host and microbiome affect the fruit flavour. We aim to go beyond genotype-phenotype associations to reveal causal pathways, that will be tested in future trials.

  The candidate will be principally advised by Assoc. Prof. Shyam Gopalakrishnan, who leads the FindingPheno project based at the Center for Evolutionary Hologenomics (https://ceh.ku.dk), with additional guidance from Prof Tom Gilbert, Director of the Center. The Gopalakrishnan research group focuses on using population and statistical genetics to understand genotype-phenotype associations with a special focus on the role of microbiomes in evolutionary processes.

  Information on the department can be found at https://globe.ku.dk.

  Your job

  You will analyse a pre-generated dataset consisting of root metagenomes, resequenced plant genomes, untargeted fruit metabolomes plus other phenotypic data from a dataset of 10 cultivars exposed to 4 different microbiome treatments. The first part of the project will focus on performing exploratory analyses to understand the relationship between host genomic processes and microbiome variations that have a significant impact on the plant fruit chemistry and other phenotypes, with a particular focus on host-microbiome interactions. Subsequently, statistical and machine learning models will be applied to better understand the biological mechanisms and pathways involved, to help design a second trial aimed at testing predictions generated from the data.

  Our research

  As part of the projects, the postdoctoral fellow will collaborate with the wider team, that additionally includes researchers at the Department of Food Science (UCPH), Aarhus University and Aalborg University. The candidate will also have an opportunity to interact with the tomato industry, such as Danish based growers. Thus, teamwork and collaboration will be important skills; however, the candidate will also be given ownership over their own research project and deliverables.

  The fully funded postdoctoral fellowship will be hosted at the Section for Hologenomics/Center for Evolutionary Hologenomics at the GLOBE Institute. As such the candidate will also have the opportunity to collaborate with leaders in the fields of world leading experts in population genetics, statistical genetics, computational biology, clinical microbiology, archaeology, evolutionary genomics, and many other related fields of research. The University of Copenhagen is a world-leading institution of higher learning and provides excellent programs in genetics, archaeology, statistics, computer science and mathematics.

  Profile 
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Essential experience and skills:

   	
• PhD degree or equivalent doctorate, with a background in one or more of the following areas: statistics, data science, statistical genetics, computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, and/or mathematics 	
• Demonstrated working proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g. Python, R, C/C++, Java or Julia) 	
• Experience working in the UNIX operating environment 	
• Excellent English skills written and spoken   Desirable experience and skills:

   	
• Previous experience or strong interest in working with large scale biological data such as genomics, metagenomics, multi-omics, etc. 	
• Experience with high-performance computing clusters/systems 	
• Experience with compiling and working with data from different sources 	
• Understanding of FAIR data principles, interest in Open Data 	
• Interest in scientific communication and/or public outreach   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Section for Hologenomics, Oester Farimagsgade 5, 1353 Copenhagen C.

  About Globe Institute
 The Globe Institute is part of the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen. The Institute’s main purpose is to address basic scientific questions through interdisciplinary approaches. The institute operates at the intersection of natural and medical sciences and the humanities. Information on the institute can be found at: http://www.globe.ku.dk/.

  The Globe Institute is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where employees and students can belong and thrive. See website for more information. All qualified applicants will receive full consideration. Candidates who, through their research, teaching, and/or service, contribute to diversity and competencies of our Institute are encouraged to apply. The University of Copenhagen strives to offer a family friendly and flexible working environment with a sustainable balance between work- and private life, including parental leave schemes (up to 47 weeks for both parents) and up to six weeks of paid holidays per year. Researchers that have not been tax liable in Denmark for the last 10 years can apply for a special (reduced) tax scheme. The university offers a variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families.

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The psoition is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 2 years. The starting date is on 1st of April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Assoc. Prof. Shyam Gopalakrishnan: shyam.gopalakrishnan@sund.ku.dk  and/or Prof. Tom Gilbert: tgilbert@sund.ku.dk .

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

  Application procedure
 Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do. 	
• List of publications.   Deadline for applications: 17 January 2027, 23.59pm CET.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 7-8 in 2027.

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

• 
Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

• 
CRI/SPA ME, or

• 
IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
EASA ATPL or CPL

• 
CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

• 
ME qualification (preferred but not required)

• 
Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Chief Flight Instructor - Denmark

About the Role

This position come with

• 
Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

• 
A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

• 
An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

• 
Access to a modern and growing fleet

• 
An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

• 
CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

• 
Instructor certificate: FI(A)

• 
Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

• 
A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

• 
Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

• 
Fluent English, spoken and written

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.occupation: Farm Worker Wanted for a Modern Pig Farm near 9352 Dybvad
jobs.description:
We are looking for a farm worker to join a well-established pig farm with 540 sows, located near 9352 Dybvad in North Jutland, Denmark.

The position primarily involves working in the breeding and gestation unit, weaner unit and farrowing unit, and you will have your own areas of responsibility within the production.

You will become part of a well-run workplace with clear expectations, established routines and proper employment conditions. The employer is a member of the Danish employers' association KA, and great importance is placed on ensuring that employees know what is expected of them, receive a good introduction to the job and have the right conditions to perform their work well.

At the same time, there is room for independence and responsibility, and you will have the opportunity to discuss professional matters and receive support from your colleagues whenever needed.

🐷 Your tasks

Your tasks will include:

• Caring for and feeding sows and piglets
• Working in the farrowing, gestation and weaner units
• Moving pigs between sections
• Castration (the farm will stop castration during the first quarter of 2027)
• Washing and cleaning livestock facilities approximately once a week
• Other practical tasks related to the daily pig production
👤 Who are we looking for?

You do not necessarily need many years of experience. Motivation, an interest in pig production and a willingness to learn are highly valued.

Previous experience from farming or livestock work is an advantage, but the position may also be suitable for a candidate with limited experience who has the right motivation and willingness to develop professionally.

We expect you to:

• Be able to work independently and take responsibility
• Work well as part of a team
• Have an interest in pig production
• Be able to communicate in English or Ukrainian
• Have a valid driving licence
• Be willing to learn the farm's routines and working procedures
⏰ Working hours

The position is an average of 37 hours per week, with work normally scheduled every second weekend.

On weekdays, working hours are typically approximately 7:00 AM to 2:30 PM. Weekend duties mainly consist of feeding the animals and monitoring their wellbeing.

✅ What we offer

• A permanent position with the aim of a long-term working relationship
• A structured and well-run workplace
• Thorough introduction and clear working procedures
• Independence and responsibility in your daily work
• Professional support and helpful colleagues
• Pension scheme and health insurance
• Work clothes and safety equipment
• Work phone
• Staff events
• Assistance with finding accommodation in the local area
📅 Starting date

As soon as possible.

📩 Interested?

Send us your CV and a short introduction about yourself.

We look forward to hearing from candidates who are looking for a stable workplace with clear expectations, proper working conditions and the opportunity for long-term employment.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed / Truck driver for foodservice company
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed.

Friske og energiske lastbilchauffør kollegaer søges hos fødevare virksomhed.

Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger medarbejdere med lyst til at levere stykgods til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for flere dygtige lastbilchauffører, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.

 

Lastbilchauffører til et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø

Som medarbejder hos os får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at leverancerne bliver udført på de aftalte tidspunkter.

 

Opgaver

-          når du møder ind, sikre dig at din lastvogn er pakket og klar til afgang

-          opsamle de nødvendige dokumenter til brug for leverancerne

-          levere stykgods til de aftalte kunder

-          andre ad. hoc lager-/ chaufføropgaver

Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øje med, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.

 

Engagement & fleksibilitet

Du har muligvis erfaring med lager- eller logistikarbejde fra en tidligere stilling. Vi søger både kolleger med og uden truckcertifikat. Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og trives godt med at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på nøjagtighed og kvalitet.

Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dine opgaver selvstændigt, og det falder dig lige så nemt at arbejde sammen med andre/et team om fælles at løse opgaverne. 

Fortrukne sprogkundskaber i prioriteret orden;

1. Tyrkisk          2. Kurdisk         3. Dansk            4. Engelsk

 

Løn

Løn aftales ifht. kvalifikationer. Som minimum aflønnes på baggrund af fælles overenskomst mellem DI Overenskomst II og 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, Transportgruppen - for lagerarbejdere, chauffører og havnearbejdere.

 

Krav

·         Du har et gyldigt kørekort C.

·         Du har allerede et gyldigt EU-bevis og førerkort eller vil opnå dette for at tiltræde stillingen.

Send din ansøgning og CV til job@megahouse.dk, markeret med ”Lastbilchauffør” i emnefeltet, så kontakter vi dig, hvis du opfylder kriterierne som kandidat til jobbet.

(ENG)

Truck driver for foodservice company

Fresh and energetic truck driver colleagues are wanted for a foodservice company.

We are a foodservice company who is seeking for employees who want to deliver bulk goods to a wide range of restaurateurs throughout Zealand.

We are a growing company and are constantly looking for new areas of work and therefore need more skilled truck drivers who can join the team with many different colleagues.

 

Truck drivers for a diverse and healthy working environment

As an employee with us, you will have a fast-paced everyday life with many tasks. Together with your colleagues, you must ensure that the deliveries are carried out at the agreed times.

 

Assignments

-          When you arrive, make sure your lorry is packed and ready for departure

-          Collect the necessary documents for use in the deliveries

-          Deliver piece goods to agreed customers/destinations

-          Other ad. hoc warehouse/driver tasks

Your development in your position, as well as opportunities for improvement, is something we keep an eye on, so that we can constantly create common and good working environment, where order, quality and automation are the focus.

 

Commitment & flexibility

You may have experience with warehouse or logistics work from a previous position. We are looking for colleagues with and without a truck certificate. It is important that you are flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where we emphasize accuracy and quality.

You are good at prioritizing and planning your tasks independently, and it is just as easy for you to work together with others/a team to jointly solve the tasks.

Preferred language skills in priority order;

1. Turkish          2. Kurdish         3. Danish          4. English

 

Salary

Salary is agreed according to qualifications. As a minimum, wages are paid on the basis of a joint agreement between DI Overenskomst II and 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, the transport group – for warehouse workers, drivers and port workers.

 

Requirements

·         You have a valid driving license C.

·         You already have a valid EU driving licence or will obtain this to fill the position.

Send your application and CV to job@megahouse.dk, marked with “Truck driver” in the subject field and we will contact you if meet the criteria as a candidate for the job.

jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturers in International Business or Business & Government
jobs.description:
A number of positions as part-time lecturer in International Business and Business & Government respectively are available at the Department of International Economics, Government and Business (EGB) for appointment as soon as possible.

EGB is a multidisciplinary department, which conducts high-quality research in the fields of international business and political science with direct relevance to business, decision-makers and the broader public.

The department delivers research-based teaching into undergraduate and graduate teaching in programs such as International Business, International Business and Politics, and International Business in Asia. To learn more about the research and teaching activities of the department, please visit the departmental website here

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with ambitious students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary (3 years) part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

The position may include
• Planning and conducting teaching in Business & Government
• Planning and conducting teaching in Strategies of Multinational Corporations and Risk management
• Planning and conducting teaching in Policy-making
• Planning and conducting teaching in Political Science with an emphasis on Comparative Politics
• Online teaching—blended learning
• Student supervision
• Preparing teaching materials and exam questions
• Conducting exams and other evaluations
Qualifications
To fill this position, you are required to have a master’s degree and must have:
• High-level practical experience, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or
• Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).
• A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits of his or her relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.
Other skills
• In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses covered by the department
• You possess good collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment
• Proficiency in both Danish and English as teaching is conducted in both Danish and English
• It is an advantage to hold a PhD in a relevant disciplineThe conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment
Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.
You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process
Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.
One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information
If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Department Jens Gammelgaard, jg.egb@cbs.dk

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Metabolomics and Metabolite Imaging at Cellular Resolution
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Environmental Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Metabolite Imaging at Cellular Resolution

Research area and project description:
This project will develop advanced methods and open-source tools for processing, analysing and interpreting MSI and spatial metabolomics data, particularly for small molecules metabolites at cellular resolution. The methods will be applied to tissue sections, microbial communities, environmental samples to understand spatial control of metabolites and their flux in an organ system.

The successful candidate will work at the interface of computational science, biochemistry, microbiology and analytical chemistry. The project will combine analytical and computational method development with experimental spatial metabolomics workflow combining MALDI-MS, tissue staining and microscopic imaging. The PhD student will join an interdisciplinary team of chemists, microbiologists, biologists and computational scientists and contribute to both methodological development and biological applications.

The position includes:
• Developing mass spectrometry imaging workflows to achieve cellular resolution.
• Integrating various imaging and staining modalities with MSI.
• Collaborating with computational scientists and biologists to validate methods against experimental and biological datasets. Ensure reliable implementation of automated quality control, testing, documentation and reproducibility reporting.
• Communicating computational results clearly to interdisciplinary and non-computational researchers. Processing and analysing imaging datasets and presenting results at internal and international scientific meetings.
• Publishing methodological and application studies and releasing well-documented open-source soft-ware.
• Close supervision and collaboration with dedicated researchers and senior investigators.
Qualifications and specific competences:
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, da-ta science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

Essential qualifications:
• Solid background in analytical chemistry, biotechnology, mass spectrometry, omics data analysis and/or mass spectrometry
• Strong interest in spatial metabolomics and its applications
Desirable qualifications:
• Experience with mass spectrometry, microscopy, microbial systems, or analytical chemistry
• Ability to work independently as well as in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship - Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities

Research area and project description:
The aim of this Ph.D. project is to develop methods for designing facades and surrounding landscapes with a regenerative environmental impact under future climate scenarios. The objective is to develop a model that predicts occupants’ satisfaction with view-out quality and visual privacy for different combinations of façade and landscape design, and to integrate it into existing indoor environmental quality (IEQ) models. Combined with assessments of material use and life-cycle environmental impacts, the model will help designers identify solutions that offer the best trade-offs between maximising occupant satisfaction and minimising the material demand and environmental impacts of the building and landscape elements. The hypothesis is that façade and landscape designs which achieve higher occupant satisfaction with both view-out quality and visual privacy are less likely to be altered in response to dissatisfaction with either aspect. This resilience is expected to extend the functional longevity of the original design and reduce the additional material use and environmental impacts associated with such alterations.

The methodological approach to establish the model will be a combination of user perception experiments on the perception of view quality and visual privacy through windows in facade systems in both lab experiments and field studies. Co-creation techniques are applied to engage with the building industry to integrate and test the model in practical design methods and workflows for climate-resilient design of buildings under future climate scenarios.
The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities, which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences:
The candidate must have an M.Sc. degree or similar in architectural engineering. Applicants are expected to have at least five years of experience from building design practice. Documented experience in digital building modelling and practical experience in user involvement processes is mandatory. Experience with evaluation of view-out quality and privacy in design practice is preferred.

jobs.occupation: Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics | Successful International Group
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a successful international distributor of specialty chemicals, with operations across a number of international markets and a presence in more than 20 countries.

The group holds a strong international position and is currently working to strengthen its presence and drive further growth in the Nordics and Baltics.

You will become a pivotal part of an international organization, with excellent opportunities to influence development and shape the direction of future commercial growth.

About the Position

As Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics, you will have overall responsibility for the business unit's development, performance, and future direction in the region.

Your primary task will be to set the strategic direction and ensure the continuous development of the business. You will play a central role in translating the group's ambitions into concrete goals and results, as well as creating the organizational and commercial framework for future growth.

In close collaboration with the Sales Director, you will develop and implement the strategy for the region and ensure progress through clear leadership, prioritization, and strong cooperation with the rest of the organization.

You will establish direction and engagement within the organization, develop leaders and employees, and ensure that the right competencies and resources are brought into play. The role requires the ability to deliver results through others while maintaining a strategic overview and an understanding of the business's commercial opportunities.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Develop leaders and employees with a focus on competencies, engagement, accountability, and collaboration.

• Translate the group's overall ambitions into concrete strategies, goals, and action plans.

• Support a company culture characterized by initiative, ownership, openness, and continuous development.

About You

You have leadership experience and a strong strategic understanding. You possess the ability to gain commitment, set direction, and develop an organization through clear leadership, involvement, and trust.

You do not necessarily need to have held a director-level position previously. The most important thing is that you have the ambition, the strategic overview, and the ability to take overall responsibility for a business unit's development and results.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience in commercial leadership and organizational development, including developing and implementing strategies and translating them into concrete goals and results.

• Are a clear leader who sets direction, builds engagement, and ensures progress.

• Thrive with overall responsibility and are able to maintain both the strategic overview and an understanding of the organization's daily operations.

• Are a modern leader who believes in freedom with responsibility and is motivated by coaching and facilitating rather than micromanaging.

• Have experience in developing people and achieving results through others.

• Possess a good financial understanding and the ability to make decisions on a sound strategic and financial basis.

• Have experience from the specialty chemicals industry or related sectors. This will be considered an advantage.

• Communicate effortlessly in both Danish and English. Additional language skills are an advantage.

What Is Offered

• A central leadership position with responsibility for an international business unit that is part of a successful global group.

• A commercial mandate with the opportunity to influence strategy and organization and leave a clear mark on the development of the Nordics and Baltics.

• A dynamic working environment combining strategic responsibility, leadership, and organizational development.

• Business travel in connection with the development of the business in the Nordics and Baltics, with significant influence over your own travel planning.

Workplace: Aarhus area.

You can be based anywhere in Denmark, as there are good opportunities for remote work. If you live outside daily commuting distance, you will be expected to work from the office approximately once a week.

Application

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to upload your CV as soon as possible.

Please upload your CV and, optionally, a short cover letter using the Apply for the Position button.

The job advertisement will be removed once the position has been filled.

All inquiries and applications will, of course, be treated confidentially.
